services.name: Farm & City Centre — Avondale
services.address: Avondale Shopping Centre, King George Road, Avondale, Harare
services.notes: Largest retail agro dealer in Harare. Stocks full range including drip kits and sprayers.

services.name: Farm & City Centre — Msasa
services.address: Msasa Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Trade and retail branch. Stocks bulk fertiliser and machinery parts.

services.name: Farm & City Centre — Westgate
services.address: Westgate Shopping Centre, Harare
services.notes: Western Harare branch. Convenient for Zvimba and Makonde farmers passing through.

services.name: ZFC Limited — Harare Depot (Willowvale)
services.address: ZFC House, 5 Willowvale Road, Willowvale Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Zimbabwe Fertilizer Company head office and main warehouse. Best prices for bulk fertiliser. Compound D, AN, and LAN always in stock during season.

services.name: Windmill (Pvt) Ltd — Harare Head Office
services.address: Windmill Park, Cnr Mutare Road & Glenara Avenue South, Msasa, Harare
services.notes: One of Zimbabwe's largest agro-input distributors. Head office stocks full range. Wholesale pricing for cooperatives.

services.name: Agricura — Head Office and Store
services.address: 67 Kelvin Road North, Msasa Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Zimbabwe's leading crop protection chemical manufacturer. Stocks full range of pesticides, herbicides, fungicides under own brand. Bulk pricing available.

services.name: Syngenta Zimbabwe — Harare Office
services.address: Msasa Business Park, Harare
services.notes: Syngenta crop protection and vegetable seeds. NK Mayai and NK Bravo tomato varieties. Trade sales only — buy through registered agro dealers.

services.name: Seed Co Zimbabwe — Head Office
services.address: 1 Argyll Road, Harare
services.notes: Head office. SC403, SC627, SC719 maize; R200 soybean; Falcon groundnut. Trade customers only at head office — buy varieties through agro dealers or Seed Co depots.

services.name: Pannar Seed — Zimbabwe Office
services.address: Stand 2, Kelvin Road, Msasa, Harare
services.notes: South African seed company with strong Zimbabwe presence. PAN 6479 and PAN 4M-23 maize hybrids. Sunflower, soybean and vegetable varieties.

services.name: Quton Seed Company — Harare
services.address: Quton House, Msasa Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Specialist cotton seed company — the main supplier of Bt and non-Bt cotton varieties in Zimbabwe. Q Suregrow and Q Deltapine varieties.

services.name: GMB — Harare Silos (Willowvale)
services.address: Willowvale Road, Willowvale Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Main GMB silo for Harare. Accepts maize, wheat, sorghum, soya, groundnuts. Bring original GMB registration card. Payment within 30 days via RTGS or USD cash.

services.name: Mbare Musika Fresh Produce Market
services.address: Mbare Musika, off Remembrance Drive, Mbare, Harare
services.notes: Zimbabwe's largest and most important fresh produce market. Highest volumes and best prices for fresh vegetables, fruit, and grain. Arrive before 07:00 for best prices. Bring your own transport and packaging.

services.name: Gulf Complex Wholesale Market
services.address: Gulf Complex, Mbare, Harare
services.notes: Adjacent to Mbare Musika. Specialist wholesale market for large volumes. Preferred by supermarket suppliers and bulk buyers.

services.name: Magaba Market — Mbare
services.address: Magaba, Mbare, Harare
services.notes: Smaller market adjoining Mbare Musika complex. Good for okra, covo, sweet corn, moringa. Attracts vendors from Chitungwiza and Epworth.

services.name: Showgrounds Farmers Market
services.address: Zimbabwe International Exhibition Centre, Belgravia, Harare
services.notes: High-value Saturday market. Best prices for premium vegetables, herbs, organics. Customers are hotels, restaurants, and high-income households. Coriander, ginger, green beans fetch 2–3x Mbare price here.

services.name: Harare Livestock Sales — Beatrice Road
services.address: Beatrice Road, Harare South
services.open_hours: Monthly auction — first Tuesday of each month
services.notes: Main cattle and livestock auction for Harare and Mashonaland. Prices set competitively by auction. Bring veterinary health certificates.

services.name: AGRITEX Provincial Office — Harare
services.address: Ministry of Agriculture, Ngungunyana Building, 4th Floor, Baker Avenue, Harare
services.notes: Provincial extension office. For field-level advice contact district offices. Free planting recommendations, soil testing referrals, and farming inputs verification.

services.name: AGRITEX District Office — Chitungwiza
services.address: Chitungwiza Town Council Offices, Chitungwiza
services.notes: District extension office. Ward-level agronomists cover all Chitungwiza wards. Book site visit through this office.

services.name: Agribank Zimbabwe — Harare Branch
services.address: Agribank House, 74 Nelson Mandela Avenue, Harare
services.notes: Agricultural Development Bank of Zimbabwe. Offers seasonal crop loans, small-scale farmer facilities, and equipment finance. Priority lending for smallholder farmers. Bring farm plan, proof of land tenure, and national ID.

services.name: AFC Holdings — Harare
services.address: AFC House, 1 Kwame Nkrumah Avenue, Harare
services.notes: Agricultural Finance Corporation — government-backed agricultural lender. Input loans disbursed directly to agro dealers on farmer's behalf. Livestock loans available. Repayment from crop proceeds after harvest.

services.name: CBZ Bank — Agricultural Division
services.address: CBZ House, Union Avenue, Harare
services.notes: Commercial Bank of Zimbabwe — largest commercial bank in Zimbabwe with strong agri lending arm. Preferred for commercial farmers with larger operations. Agricultural portfolio includes tobacco finance, horticulture, and large-scale irrigation.

services.name: Agricultural Marketing Authority (AMA)
services.address: AMA House, 1 Adylinn Road, Belvedere, Harare
services.notes: Government body regulating agricultural marketing. Publishes official market prices weekly — check for maize, wheat, soya and livestock prices. Registers commodity buyers and exporters.

services.name: Tobacco Industry and Marketing Board (TIMB)
services.address: TIMB House, Corner Adylinn and Piers Road, Belvedere, Harare
services.notes: Register as a tobacco grower before planting. Buying season March–November. Zimbabwe is the world's premier flue-cured tobacco producer. Registration required — cannot sell without TIMB grower number.

services.name: Irrigation & Equipment Zimbabwe (IEZ)
services.address: Msasa Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Drip irrigation kits, sprinkler systems, pumps, pipes. Sizing and installation service available. Netafim and Rain Bird equipment stocked. Best source for small-scale drip kits for vegetable production.

services.name: National Foods — Grain Processing
services.address: National Foods, Workington Industrial Area, Harare
services.notes: Zimbabwe's largest grain miller. Buys maize and wheat directly from commercial farmers in large volumes. Smallholders should sell through GMB — National Foods buys primarily from GMB stock.

services.name: Henderson Research Station
services.address: Henderson Research Station, Mazowe Road, 25 km north of Harare
services.notes: National research station under DRSS. Focus on maize, soybean and grain legume variety development. Open days held annually — attend for latest variety trial results and free agronomic advice.
